macro_goal_and_topology_alignment: UAOS remains the cross-domain control/governance plane while children remain direct business work planes.
The repair must strengthen inheritance observability and parent guidance without turning UAOS into a per-turn proxy, child-state mirror or business microscheduler.

Reliability target is fewer defects, bounded blast radius, earlier detection, faster recovery and better learning; zero future defects is not a supportable architecture claim for probabilistic Agents and changing external environments.
governing_assumption_challenge: Rejected: a manifest/common-capability pointer proves inherited behavior is operational.
Rejected: a green parent regression suite proves child currentness when tests freeze historical releases.
Rejected: all child upcalls should enter one global FIFO queue.
Rejected: excellent architecture should eliminate the need for simulation, fault injection or live observation.
Rejected: a popular external Skill should be installed because popularity implies quality.

external_research.impact: Supported domain/upcall fault boundaries so one blocked case does not impair unrelated domains.
Supported deliberate failure/recovery experiments to expose unanticipated weaknesses and avoid known-issue-only governance.
Supported structured causal history and aggregation across incidents to identify systemic/common failure classes.

Supported using external Skills as reviewable method candidates; SkillsMP itself states public indexing is not quality/safety certification. Candidate patterns inspected included agent-introspection-debugging, agent-native-architecture and verification-loop.

counterexamples_and_tradeoffs: A new central supervisor queue was rejected because it duplicates existing scheduling/control and creates another bottleneck.
Copying parent cognition implementation into each child was rejected because it increases divergence and confuses common-method ownership with domain business ownership.

Blocking every child when a common cause is merely suspected was rejected because it amplifies blast radius; cluster evidence first and widen blocking only when a hard shared dependency is established.
Static policy checks alone were rejected as sufficient for unknown failures; scenario/replay/failure injection/live observation remain distinct assurance layers.
